Definition: a threshing-floor (as made even); by analogy, any open area
BiblicalUsage: gôren is a plain word for a threshing-floor. In Genesis 50:10, the text says "And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad." In Numbers 15:20, the text says "as [ye do] the heave offering of the threshingfloor."
TheologicalSignificance: gôren convinces me that God's judgment is just, and it falls where it should — no one escapes it, and no one suffers it unjustly. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
